taxonomy.why: Evaluation lanes were previously listed alongside frozen configurations as if they were peer candidates. They are not: re-evaluating one frozen configuration in five ways is not five candidates, and counting it that way would both inflate the candidate list and corrupt multiple-testing accounting.

levels.HYPOTHESIS_FAMILY: a research idea that may contain several frozen configurations
levels.FROZEN_CONFIGURATION: one exact, hash-pinned effective identity - the unit that counts as a tested configuration
levels.EVALUATION_LANE: one way of evaluating a frozen configuration; never a new configuration
levels.ROBUSTNESS_ANALYSIS: a sensitivity applied to an existing lane; never a new configuration
levels.METHOD_REFERENCE: studied for method only; never executed as a ranked candidate

parameter_provenance.selection_evidence: The pinned public grid in research/sweep_funding.py tests funding_max_pct [40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100] and ema_period [500, 600, 700]. 55 is NOT in that grid. Upstream's README states the rationale - 'The filter is set to 55, not the best-performing 60. Picking the exact peak of a sweep is how you fool yourself; 50, 55 and 60 all work, so take the middle.' - so 55 is a documented midpoint between two swept values, but the sweep evidence for 55 itself is not public.
parameter_provenance.rule: Do not invent missing sweep evidence. Execute the published 55; record that its selection is only partially documented.

LOCAL_TRIAL_COUNT.basis: H1_EMACROSS and H2_EMACROSSFUNDING - the frozen configurations this lab selects and tests
LOCAL_TRIAL_COUNT.excluded: evaluation lanes and robustness analyses; re-evaluating one frozen configuration is not an additional trial

basis: EmaCross was selected as the winner of a 42-strategy benchmark (33 lost money outright)
the funding rule was then added to that already-selected winner - upstream names both selection steps itself
the public grid sweeps 3 ema_period x 7 funding_max_pct = 21 combinations
the published funding_max_pct=55 is not in that grid, so at least one further selection step is undocumented
upstream discarded a prior strategy at PBO 1.00 before arriving at this one

TOTAL_SELECTION_PROVENANCE.rule: A low LOCAL_TRIAL_COUNT does not make the family lightly-tested. The configurations we run arrive pre-selected from a 42-way benchmark plus a 21-point sweep plus an undocumented midpoint choice, and that history is not reset by our re-evaluating them.
TOTAL_SELECTION_PROVENANCE.hard_rule: Do NOT claim DSR or PBO certification from LOCAL_TRIAL_COUNT alone. Any deflated-Sharpe or PBO figure must state which trial count it used and acknowledge the upstream selection debt it cannot observe.
